title: KeyEncryptionAlgorithm::EcdhEs is dead public API — callers cannot trigger it
description: KeyEncryptionAlgorithm::EcdhEs { curve: EcCurve } is a public enum variant documented as 'Reserved; currently not produced by decrypt()'. The decrypt() implementation only produces RsaPkcs1v15 and RsaOaep for KTRI. KARI goes through agree_ecdh(), not decrypt_cek(). So no caller will ever see EcdhEs in their decrypt_cek() implementation. Callers who implement DecryptionKey will write match arms for EcdhEs that can never be exercised, or they will use a catch-all and be confused when EcdhEs never appears. Either the variant should be removed, or the documentation should explicitly say it will never appear in decrypt_cek() calls and is purely for future signaling (which raises the question: signaling what, to whom?). This public variant is a maintenance liability: it is part of the API contract but has no defined semantics.
close_reason: Documentation at the variant and type level is already explicit: 'not produced by the current decrypt() implementation'. Removing the variant would be a breaking API change. Won't-fix.
